# Joseph Lawhorn

## Business Analytics & Insurance Professional

I am a commercial property and casualty insurance professional with a strong interest in business analytics, data, and cloud technology. My professional experience has given me a practical understanding of risk analysis, decision-making, and using data to evaluate business opportunities.

I am currently expanding my technical skills through graduate coursework in Big Data and Cloud Analytics for Business. Through this program, I am developing experience with Python, data visualization, cloud computing, AWS, GitHub, machine learning, and analytics tools.

## Career Goals

My goal is to combine my experience in commercial insurance and underwriting with analytics and technology. I am particularly interested in using data to improve business decisions, identify trends, evaluate risk, and create more efficient processes.

As I continue developing my technical skills, I want to build a career that combines business knowledge with data analytics and emerging cloud technologies.
